participation.context: Promised two mornings in March, named no sum, and repeated the date without making it a plan for another house.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Drove the knife two inches, cursed Allen, and asked for a carpenter's mornings rather than a vision.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Asked who pays the carpenter, and kept the price out of William's mouth.
participation.name: Cuthbert Burbage

relations.note: he will not let a rotten post become a speech about the lease

story.body: You felt the post take the knife. You promised two Lent mornings. You refused a price, and you left Allen's law with the family.

relations.note: he will not let a rotten post become a speech about the lease

title: Gave two mornings in March to the carpenter

participation.context: Looked close at the post and did not put a price on it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the rotten mortise and the wet grass beside it.

participation.context: Wrote the margin note and went on to open the play.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote one line in the margin and left the speeches on the roll. The afternoon's playing is not on this page.

title: Wrote a margin line in The Comedy of Errors
